purpose: Teach: 基幹/分譲/大差/特価/シチュエーション/通算/表題/ラインナップ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 基幹システムの更新を計画しましょう
lines.en: Let's create a plan for the core system update.
lines.style: Calm, measured opening. Clear authority without harshness. Even pace. Forward-looking and business-like.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規分譲物件の見学会を企画しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm organizing a viewing event for the new subdivision properties.
lines.style: Responsive and professional. Slight lift on the affirmative—eager to confirm understanding. Steady, reliable delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社と他社の大差を明確にしましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we highlight what sets us apart from the competition.
lines.style: Directive but not commanding. Light emphasis on 'us apart.' Measured pace. Assumes agreement, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。期間限定の特価コーナーを設けました
lines.en: Yes. I've set up a limited-time discount section.
lines.style: Direct update, clipped and efficient. Small note of completion-pride. Professional, no flourish.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様のシチュエーション別にメニューを分けましょう
lines.en: Let's organize the menu options by customer situation and need.
lines.style: Clear directive with slight forward momentum. Reasonable expectation in the voice. Even tempo, collaborative rather than top-down.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。半期通算実績を発表しました
lines.en: Yes. I've released the half-year results.
lines.style: Factual announcement. Quiet confidence. Flat delivery on the accomplishment—let the work speak for itself.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プレゼンの表題をキャッチーにしましょう
lines.en: Let's make the presentation title catchier and more memorable.
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion, not demand. Slight pause before 'catchier'—weighing the word. Inviting input rather than imposing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。冬の新商品ラインナップを揃えました
lines.en: Yes. I've finalized the winter product lineup.
lines.style: Completion note. Warm close. Slightly brighter than previous updates—wrapping up well. Confident, satisfied delivery.
